parsed.rationale: After upgrading to v2.8, the Salesforce sync has been failing since yesterday with repeated auth token refresh errors, blocking reporting for about 40 enterprise customers and requiring help ASAP for a renewal call tomorrow.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for the details. I’m sorry you’re seeing production sync failures after the v2.8 upgrade. Since you’re getting repeated Salesforce auth token refresh errors and this is blocking reporting for ~40 enterprise customers, we will escalate this for immediate engineering review.

To help us zero in quickly (especially for your renewal call tomorrow), could you share the following minimum details:
1) Which Salesforce sync/integration job(s) are failing (job name(s) or connector name), and whether it’s production only.
2) The exact auth token refresh error text from the logs (a few lines around the failure), ideally including the timestamp.
3) Confirm whether it started immediately after the v2.8 upgrade or at a specific time after.
4) For one affected tenant, whether the Salesforce credentials/auth connection were recently rotated/changed (if applicable).

Once we have those, engineering can review the logs and advise next steps. We’ll also keep you updated as the investigation progresses.
promised_actions: Escalate the issue to engineering for immediate review
Request the minimum log and job details needed to proceed
safety_notes: Did not promise a fix or refund, and did not claim root cause.
Requested specific, minimum clarifications to reduce ambiguity (job names, exact error text, timing, credential changes).

grounded_facts: The system was upgraded to v2.8 yesterday.
The Salesforce sync has been failing since the v2.8 upgrade.
Logs show repeated auth token refresh errors.
The reporting is blocked for about 40 enterprise customers.
A renewal call is scheduled for tomorrow and help is needed ASAP.
